HediffDef.label: queen's hive authority
HediffDef.description: A living Wraith Queen is coordinating this pawn through the local hive network. Shared intent sharpens movement, manipulation and conscious response.

HediffDef.label: provisional hive coordination
HediffDef.description: An acting Wraith regent is holding the local hive network together after the loss of its Queen. Coordination has returned, but remains weaker than true Queen authority.

HediffDef.label: queenless hive disruption
HediffDef.description: The local Wraith hive has lost an established Queen and has not yet resolved succession. Telepathic command fragments into competing impulses, impairing coordination and conscious response.

HediffDef.label: acting hive regent
HediffDef.description: This Wraith has assumed provisional local authority after the loss of a true Queen. The role can restore basic hive coordination, but it does not equal a Queen's biological and psychic command.
